name: What should I do immediately if I suspect a cracked sewer pipe?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately if I suspect a cracked sewer pipe?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you suspect a cracked sewer pipe, the first step is to minimize water usage in your home to prevent further leakage and potential damage. Avoid flushing toilets, running dishwashers, or using washing machines. If you can locate your main water shut-off valve, turning off the water supply to your home can help. Next, contact a professional plumbing service immediately. They can perform an inspection to confirm the issue and recommend the appropriate repair steps, preventing the problem from escalating.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minimize water usage, avoid flushing toilets, and immediately contact a professional plumbing service for an inspection.
